quest.title: Yata Kouki's Order of Ore
quest.description: Narukami Island's Yata Kouki requests 5 White Iron Chunks.

talks.objective: Give five White Iron Chunks to Yata Kouki

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You wanted some White Iron Chunks?

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: You can't sharpen your blade if it goes blunt in battle. So, best to have Mr. Amenoma make me a shiny new one well in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Have you taken on my commission? If so, I guess you've got those 5 White Iron Chunks.

response.speaker: Yata Kouki
response.text: Alright, well just bring them here once you've got them.

dialogues.speaker: Yata Kouki
dialogues.text: Thanks a million. Please take this as a small token of my gratitude.
